entries.Deep underneath the Heart Mountains, a n: Deep underneath the Heart Mountains, a new tribe of trolls awakens. Help them grow and eventually fulfil Ougl Firstborn’s biggest dream.
entries.There are many unexplainable things in t: There are many inexplicable things in this world. This is one of them: the little ant decided to join the trolls.
entries.Soon Ougl saw that they had come to a de: Soon Ougl saw that they had come to a dead end. The way forwards was blocked by rock and stone.
entries.Ougl loved this strange new green color,: Ougl loved this strange new green colour, and there was plenty of it here.
entries.They are well known for frantically mini: They are well known for frantically mining treasures and adorning themselves with jewels. Less well known is that they practise a mysterious kind of magic.
entries.female^Potion grants steadfast ability a: Potion grants steadfast ability and 20% resistance to impact.
